prose.en: Tori seizes the instant when uke moves to the left and the right foot comes level with the left, and, pivoting on the right foot, sweeps from the side, near uke's right ankle, using the arch of the left foot, to throw.

Image of the technique and the ukemi (breakfall). Uke's cooperation: When the right foot is swept, uke brings both feet together and takes yoko-ukemi (side breakfall). Tori's cooperation: Tori pulls up on uke's right sleeve so that uke can take a solid ukemi. Moving diagonally forward, tori breaks uke's balance sideways and throws by sweeping uke's ankle with the left foot.

heading.en: Introductory way of applying the technique

prose.en: Moving sideways with following steps (tsugi-ashi), tori practises the timing for applying okuri-ashi-barai.
Apply okuri-ashi-barai at the instant when uke moves backwards (sideways) and both feet come together.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori must not apply the technique with the hips pulled back.
